In Cyberneering, Communication is the essence of Systems, Human-beings and Agents.

The principle states:

<div style='opacity:.3;font-family:serif;font-style:italic;line-height:1'>"So long as one can follow the chain of Communication, a System may be as complex as Locally necessary."</div>

It also states, by proposition, that all issues in Systems may be described in terms of Errors of Communication.


Communication is the basis of Continuity.
